text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool in this session, so please run it to confirm. I checked each fix by reading it against its test.

- **`fees.py`**: the fee used `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It now multiplies: `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, as the policy comment and tests say.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns `[-n:]`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing the third title. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
